about: Tenant in Pune, whole Rs 60,000 deposit withheld for painting and a tap; four rounds of consultation, then a legal notice sent personally

turns.text: Hi, I need help. I was renting a 2BHK flat in Baner, Pune from Mr. Suresh Kulkarni from 1 November 2024. I paid a security deposit of Rs 60,000 by bank transfer. I vacated on 30 September 2026 after giving one month's notice on WhatsApp. Now he is refusing to return the deposit. He says he will deduct for painting the whole flat and for a broken bathroom tap. What can I do?

To answer your questions:
1. Yes, there is a registered 11-month leave and licence agreement, renewed in October 2025. Clause 7 says the deposit is refundable at the end 'after deducting for damages, if any'. It says nothing about painting.
2. I paid the deposit by NEFT on 28 October 2024. I have the bank statement.
3. I took dated photos and a video of every room on 30 September when I handed over the keys. The walls only have normal marks from two years of living. The only thing broken was the bathroom tap washer, which had been leaking since June; I told him about it on WhatsApp in June and he said he would send a plumber but never did.
4. On 3 October he messaged: 'painting will cost 35,000 and plumbing 5,000, rest I will see'. Since then he has not paid anything and stopped replying.
5. Rent was Rs 22,000 a month and I paid everything up to September. No dues.
6. I now live at a new address in Wakad, Pune.

Thanks. He finally replied yesterday (6 November 2026). He says he will keep Rs 40,000 and return Rs 20,000 'only if you sign that you have no further claims'. Should I accept? What if he argues the flat needed painting because I lived there for two years? I want the full amount back, but I am willing to pay a fair cost for the tap washer if he shows a bill.
I don't want to sign that. I'd like to send him a proper legal notice myself, not through a lawyer. Please prepare it.

about: Hinglish: defective phone from an online marketplace, return rejected as 'physical damage'; grievance officer and 1915 first, then a District Commission complaint

turns.text: Maine 18 October 2026 ko ek online marketplace (ShopKart) se Rs 15,999 ka phone liya. 20 October ko delivery hui aur 2 din mein screen pe green line aa gayi aur touch kaam nahi kar raha. Return request daali to 'physical damage' bol ke reject kar di, jabki phone pe ek scratch bhi nahi hai. Ab kya karu?

Aapke sawaalon ke jawab:
1. Payment UPI se kiya tha, invoice mere email pe hai. Seller ka naam 'MobiWorld Retail' hai, ShopKart sirf platform hai.
2. Mere paas unboxing video hai, aur green line wali screen ki photos aur video bhi.
3. Customer care se 3 baar baat ki, ticket number SK-88213. Har baar bolte hain 'decision final hai'.
4. 1 November ko brand ke authorised service centre gaya tha. Unhone job sheet di jisme likha hai 'display panel defect, no physical damage', lekin bole replacement ke liye seller se baat karo.
5. Main Lucknow mein rehta hu.
6. Mujhe paisa wapas chahiye ya naya phone, aur jo pareshani hui uska compensation bhi.

4 November ko ShopKart ke grievance officer ko email kiya, abhi tak jawab nahi aaya. NCH 1915 pe bhi complaint kar di, docket number NCH-2026-1104-7781. Kitna compensation maang sakta hu? Aur kya ShopKart aur seller dono ke khilaf case ho sakta hai?
Theek hai. Agar unka jawab nahi aaya to main District Commission jaunga. Consumer complaint ka draft bana do.

HR ने कल व्हाट्सऐप पर लिखा कि 'कंपनी घाटे में है, दिसंबर तक आधा पैसा देंगे'। क्या मुझे यह मान लेना चाहिए? और श्रम विभाग में शिकायत कैसे करूँ? PF के लिए क्या करूँ?
ठीक है, पहले कंपनी को कानूनी नोटिस भेजना चाहता हूँ। मैं खुद भेजूँगा। ड्राफ्ट बना दीजिए।
